calculation.description: Ten-day cross-asset momentum scaled by 20-day annualized realized volatility and weighted by the recent-to-baseline volume participation ratio. Positive values indicate stronger risk-adjusted momentum with recent volume confirmation. All inputs are lagged at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate IC is robust over the full sample and strong in 2027-2028, but negative in 2029 and 2030 YTD; use conservative sizing and monitor regime dependence. Short-horizon predictive decay is favorable at 5 days and reverses by 20 days.

signal_provenance.method: daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation between factor values and forward returns; dates require at least 8 valid instruments
